common.lowSample: Low sample (fewer than {{min}}): treat as a signal, not a result.
common.truncated: The list was truncated to the first 5,000 records; figures cover that subset only.

page.title: Growth analytics
page.subtitle: Staff only. Every figure is labelled measured or estimated and shows its sample size and formula.
page.northStar: North Star (proposed): weekly active accounts that created at least one real booking from an answered call. Pending your confirmation of what counts as a booking.

reason.no_opening_cohort: No paying accounts at the start of the period.
reason.no_matured_trials: No trial has reached its end date plus the settlement window yet.
reason.no_signups_observed_for_window: No signup has been observed for the full window yet.
reason.history_too_short: Less than 6 months of subscription history.
reason.zero_observed_churn: No churn observed, so the estimate would be unbounded.
reason.invalid_margin: Gross margin must be above 0% and at most 100%.
reason.no_new_customers: No new paying customers in this period.
reason.no_spend_recorded: No spend recorded for this channel and period.

revenue.bridgeHint: Opening MRR plus new, reactivation and expansion, minus contraction and churn, equals closing MRR.
revenue.noHistory: No paying-subscription history yet. Run the backfill or wait for the first Stripe subscription event.
revenue.noFx: Currencies are never converted or summed together.
revenue.residual: The bridge does not reconcile (difference {{amount}}). Treat revenue figures as unreliable until the data-quality checks pass.
revenue.nrrFormula: (opening + expansion − contraction − churn) ÷ opening, opening cohort only
revenue.grrFormula: Σ min(closing, opening) ÷ opening, capped at 100%
revenue.logoChurnFormula: opening paying accounts now at zero MRR ÷ opening paying accounts
revenue.cohortsHint: Cohort = month of first payment. Cell = share of the cohort still paying at the end of that month.
revenue.noCohorts: No paying cohort in the last 12 months.
revenue.cohortLegend: Cohorts under 30 accounts are marked low sample. Months in progress are partial.

acq.activationHint: Activated = first real call (20 s or longer, not the guided test call). Persona-level activation is not available: there is no persona data yet.

step.name: Step
step.booking: First job created from a real call

acq.activatedFormula: signups activated within the window ÷ signups observed for the full window (younger signups excluded)
acq.ttfvSummary: Among {{n}} activated accounts: median {{median}} h, 90th percentile {{p90}} h.
acq.ttfvCaveat: This covers activated accounts only, so it understates the true time: accounts that have not activated yet are not in it.
acq.trialHint: Only trials past their end date plus a 3-day settlement window are counted. Running trials are shown separately, never as failures.
acq.noTrials: No trials recorded in this period.
acq.trialFormula: trials that paid by end date + 3 days ÷ matured trials
acq.unitHint: CAC uses spend you enter manually. LTV and payback are estimates because they need your gross-margin assumption.
acq.marginHint: Your assumption, not a measured value. Required for LTV and payback.
acq.needMargin: Enter a gross margin to see LTV and payback. Nothing is estimated without it.
acq.ltvFormula: ARPA × gross margin ÷ monthly logo churn
acq.ltvNeedsInputs: LTV needs a gross margin and an observed churn rate.
acq.monthlyChurn: Monthly logo churn derived from the last 90 days: {{value}}
acq.noChurnObserved: Monthly churn is not available (no opening cohort).
acq.spendNotAligned: The period does not cover whole calendar months, so spend and customers may not line up. Use a full-month period for CAC.
acq.coverage: Only {{attributed}} of {{total}} new customers have attribution (consent-gated). The rest appear as channel “unknown”.
acq.cacFormula: CAC = recorded spend ÷ new paying customers of that channel.
acq.minSample: Figures with fewer than {{min}} observations carry a low-sample warning.

spend.title: Marketing spend (manual)
spend.hint: One amount per channel and month. The channel must match the utm_source value used in campaign links.
spend.empty: No spend recorded in this period.
spend.invalid: Check the fields: channel (letters, digits, . _ ~ -), month, amount of 0 or more, 3-letter currency.

plans.unmapped: Some subscriptions have no plan mapping. Add rows to growth_price_plan_map for each Stripe price.
plans.pathsHint: Plan changes between two paying states within the period.
plans.noPaths: No plan changes in this period.
plans.reasonsHint: From the cancel flow (reason selected by the customer). Free-text details are not shown here.
plans.noReasons: No cancellation with a reason in this period.
plans.atRiskBody: Account health, adoption and NPS already power the at-risk list. It is not duplicated here.

exp.principles: Rules: tenant-level assignment, fixed minimum runtime (no early stopping), guardrail on cancellations, and no dark patterns. Pricing tests only show the price that will actually be charged and never include existing paying customers.
exp.name: Name
exp.invalid: Check the fields: key format, name, hypothesis length, share 5–95, runtime 7–90 days.
exp.createFailed: Could not create the experiment (is the key already used?).
exp.priceIntegrity: I confirm the price shown to every arm equals the price charged, and that pricing/legal review is done.

reason.srm_failed: Sample ratio mismatch: the arms are not the size they should be, so results cannot be trusted.
reason.arm_missing: One arm has no accounts yet.
reason.sample_below_minimum: An arm has fewer than 30 observations.
reason.too_few_events: Too few events or non-events in an arm for a reliable test.
reason.runtime_not_reached: The minimum runtime has not been reached; no verdict is issued early.
reason.guardrail_unknown: Not enough paying accounts to judge the cancellation guardrail.

ops.alertsHint: Evaluated by the weekly digest job. Each rule fires at most once a week until acknowledged.
ops.dqHint: Checks that the revenue tables can be trusted.
ops.recHint: Compares Stripe's live subscriptions with the recorded facts. Detects missed webhooks and MRR drift.
ops.recFailed: Reconciliation failed. Check the function logs.
ops.recSummary: Last run {{when}}: {{n}} Stripe subscriptions checked, {{m}} unexplained mismatch(es).
ops.recTruncated: Stripe returned more subscriptions than the cap; missing-in-Stripe checks were skipped.

dq.subscription_events_without_fact_90d: Events without a recorded fact (90 days)
dq.profiles_with_subscription_but_no_fact: Accounts with a subscription but no fact
dq.prices_without_plan_map: Stripe prices without a plan mapping
dq.facts_with_unresolved_discount: Facts with a discount that is not applied to MRR
dq.unsupported_interval_active: Active subscriptions with an unsupported interval
